_comment: Commits from zulip/zulip, replayed through DocBot's triage and drafting.
cases change the product and its help centre together. The code change goes to
the model with the help centre as it was before; the model decides whether the
change has doc impact and which help pages to edit. The pages the commit's
author edited, and what they wrote, are the reference the model never sees.
negatives change code only, and by their subject change nothing a user sees:
triage should answer no-doc-impact. That label is read from the commit, not
ignore plays the part of doc-map.json: paths whose changes never call for a
help-centre update, dropped before the model sees the diff.
Fetch the repository with scripts/fetch-zulip.sh. Replay with

cases.change: mirroring removed; forging DMs gated on a permission
reporting a message now sends a confirmation
link previews can be hidden per recipient
a popover shows topics that link to a topic
quote and forward hotkeys apply to a selection
per-channel default for push notifications; also adds a page
Ctrl+] and Ctrl+[ indent list items; also adds pages
legacy push notifications skipped when E2EE is required

negatives.change: backend: a helper simplified to use a set
frontend: the message quote format moved into a shared module
backend: user group views moved between modules
frontend: search typeahead filterers extracted into a helper
integrations: a GitHub webhook helper extracted
frontend CSS: dark theme loading indicator fill cleaned up

excluded.why: dependency upgrade; the help edits are incidental
typo cleanup across code and docs
lint fix: http to https in a link
library removal; the help edit follows the library, not the product
